title: Russian Pilaf with Umami Cheese
description: A hearty Russian-inspired pilaf dish infused with umami flavors and topped with melted stracciatella cheese.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Sauté chopped onion and minced garlic until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start browning, about 5 minutes.
Add tomato paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, until fragrant.
Stir in cooked pilaf and cook for about 2-3 minutes, until the pilaf is well coated with the umami sauce.
Transfer the pilaf mixture to a serving dish.
Top with shredded stracciatella cheese and place under the broiler until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
